rows: A small tornado was spotted by the public as it touched down east of Hye. The tornado destroyed a barn, then lifted back up into the parent thunderstorm. No other damage was indicated.
A second tornado touched down west of Johnson City very close to the time of the first tornado. This tornado was on the ground for three-quarters of a mile and destroyed 3 barns as it moved east.

Winds from severe thunderstorms blew down trees down and damaged power lines between Blanco and Johnson City. Power was out to both cities for several hours. The storms also caused damage to roofs in Johnson City, with considerable damage to the roof of the Blanco County Jail.
